get.description:
Returns the list of all impact levels configured in the system (SD_IMPACT table).

Example: `http://your-server/api/v1/{account}/impacts`

Notes:
- Results are read-only; impacts are managed via the EasyVista administration console.
- Use `max_rows`, `sort`, `fields`, and `search` query parameters to control the output.

parameters.name: max_rows

Example: __/impacts?max_rows=5__

parameters.name: fields

Selected fields to be returned.

Example: __/impacts?fields=IMPACT_ID,IMPACT_EN__

200.description: A paginated list of impact records.

IMPACT_ID.description: Unique identifier of the impact level.

HREF.description: Hypermedia link to the impact record.

get.description:
Returns List of known problems.

This resource helps you to get known problems list.
If no options are provided, an excerpt of the records is displayed.

Example: http://your_server/api/v1/account/known-problems?max_rows=3&fields=answer_en,creation_date,last_update_ut,version&sort=last_update_ut desc

Notes:
- Some sensitive fields reserved to Easyvista are not returned.

PROBLEM_METASTATUS.description: Problem metastatus linked to the known problem status.

KNOWLEDGE_UNITS.description: List of related Knowledge Units linked to this known problem.

KNOWN_PROBLEMS_NEXT_KU_ID.description: ID of the linked Knowledge Unit.

HREF.description: API link to the Knowledge Unit resource.

PREV_KNOWLEDGE_UNITS.description: List of Known Problems that reference this one as their next suggested Knowledge Unit (i.e. its previous Knowledge Units).

KNOWN_PROBLEMS_PREV_KU_ID.description: ID of the linked Knowledge Unit.

HREF.description: API link to the Knowledge Unit resource.

400.description: Bad Request - invalid query parameter value.

error.example: Invalid value for query parameter "user_lng": "xx". Allowed values are: <enabled languages configured in AM_LANGUAGE, e.g. en, fr-FR, es, de, it, pt-PT>.

parameters.name: user_lng
parameters.description:
Filters language-specific fields to only return the requested language.

Accepted values (case-insensitive) are the I18N codes of the languages enabled in AM_LANGUAGE (e.g. `en`, `fr-FR`, `es`, `de`, `it`, `pt-PT`), restricted to the languages actually supported by this resource's QUESTION_XX/ANSWER_XX columns. The exact list depends on server configuration.

When provided:
- `KNOWN_PROBLEMS_PATH` will only contain the entry for the requested language (e.g. `KNOWN_PROBLEMS_PATH_FR`)
- `QUESTION_*` and `ANSWER_*` fields will be filtered to only return the requested language variant

Example: `/known-errors?user_lng=fr-FR`

Example 1.ANSWER_EN:
Most newer scanners and cameras are Plug and Play, and Windows 2000 installs the necessary drivers for them automatically. However, drivers for some devices may need to be installed manually.

Even if drivers for your device are already installed, they may be corrupted. Installing a new driver may fix the problem.

To install drivers for a camera or scanner

Open Scanners and Cameras in Control Panel.
If your device is listed, click it, and then click Remove.
Click Add, and follow the instructions in the wizard to install the device and its drivers.
Note

To open a Control Panel item, click Start, point to Settings, click Control Panel, and then double-click the appropriate icon.

put.description:
To close an incident or request, update it with the optional "close" object.

This close object must contains a valid status GUID, and optional fields like "end date". Doing so, the workflow will be stopped, the incident/request will be closed and further updates will be impossible.

Upon success an HTTP 201 OK is returned. The URI to the updated resources is provided, and the HTTP Header constains a location information to redirect the client to the newly created resource.

If the record is not found, a 404 error is returned.

If the record is not found, a 404 error is returned.

Starts the workflow for a given incident or request.

Upon success, an HTTP 200 OK is returned with the workflow execution details.

If the record is not found, a 404 error is returned.
